areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Recovers vulnerable, degraded urban areas, with positive environmental impact and urban resilience to floods.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Sanitation is part of the programme, with sewer collection networks across the city and specific basins.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Integrated, resilient actions on risk management, drainage structures and water resilience address water-security deficits.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Watercourse requalification creates ecological corridors, with planted tree islands and grass on banks sheltering fauna.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Territorial development and social engagement components (sewerage, paving, housing, rent support, social work) directly benefit low-income residents of flood-prone areas.
